Talia: noticed weirdness: SDKs not surfacing retry hints so apps hammer the API after a fallback.
Ben: example?
Talia: client got 200 + payload from fallback model, but X-Redwood-Retry was missing. app retried immediately.
Ravi: proposal: small contract - X-Redwood-Landing (enum), X-Redwood-Retry-Hint (seconds|none) and body `subcode`.
Ben: add `retry_action` enum (immediate_backoff|delayed|no_retry) so UX not tied to seconds.
Liz (devex): console should mirror that enum: show "Try again in ~30s" for delayed, "Upgrade" for no_retry. consistent copy with support playbook.
Talia: telemetry: tag traces with `landing_subcode` and `retry_hint`, plus counters for suggested vs performed retries.
ops-bot: ops-bot: feature-flag retry-hint-headers -> canary at 2026-03-21T16:45:00Z
Ravi: will draft RFC with header names, enum vocab, metric names and sample curl/sdk snippets. QA checklist: header present, body subcode, metric emitted, console mapping.
Ben: curl sample for RFC:
curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK
# X-Redwood-Landing: capacity_fallback
# X-Redwood-Retry-Hint: 30s
# body: {"subcode":"capacity_fallback","content":"..."}
Liz (devex): will prototype banner variations and support flowcard.
Talia: thanks, dropping RFC link shortly unless anyone objects.
